items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out in lane. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-11,200 (levels 1-18). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Kinetic Carbine T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Headhunter, vitality 4.8k at Veil Walker. Ultimate (Paradoxical Swap) is available from Headhunter.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Long Range
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 3,200 souls on. Upgrade of Long Range, High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Headhunter completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Headhunter completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Headhunter
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 18 to 54% weapon damage. Upgrade of Headshot Booster (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Veil Walker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 11,200-27,200 (levels 18-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Time Wall T3, Paradoxical Swap T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pulse Grenade, pulse damage) grows from 42.4 to 59.5. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Express Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Compress Cooldown, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Kinetic Carbine: takes 18% off its 16s base cooldown.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Hollow Point
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 141s; 20% off is 28.2s per full rotation.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 27,200-51,200 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Pulse Grenade T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pulse Grenade, pulse damage) grows from 59.5 to 138.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 45 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Hollow Point.
sections.desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Hollow Point.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep landing on you.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you can't get back to range.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this. Otherwise sell Veil Walker.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
